evidence.quote: No spondylolisthesis is demonstrated at any level in either projection.

The only diagnosis documented is degenerative disc disease, which the criteria explicitly exclude.

evidence.quote: Nine months of conservative management, from 12 August 2025 to the date of this letter.

results.explanation: The summary letter states nine months of conservative management spanning 12 Aug 2025 to 18 Jun 2026 (over 6 months), which on its face would meet the threshold; however the underlying physiotherapy episode closed 28 Jan 2026 and the only other documented modality (ESI) occurred 04 Mar 2026, so the dated component records do not by themselves establish a continuous 6-month course, leaving the letter's summary characterization as the primary support without independent corroboration of continuity.
